tagline: Modernizing data infrastructure for the AI era
hero_kpi_rationale: The HPC/Cloud segment is the primary growth driver for PSTG, as it directly captures demand from AI adoption and data-intensive workloads, particularly through hyperscalers and cloud-native applications.

kpis.name: AI/Cloud Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to storage solutions for artificial intelligence and cloud environments.
kpis.description: This revenue includes sales to hyperscalers and FlashBlade solutions used for AI model training. A major delivery with a hyperscaler was completed in 2026.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by hyperscalers and AI

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high due to software integration and manufacturing cost optimization through external partners.
kpis.signal: High margin for a hardware manufacturer

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving with the scaling of recurring revenue and better expense discipline.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D investments remain high to accelerate innovation in flash modules and software automation.
kpis.signal: High level typical of tech leaders

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (cloud and software)
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Investments focus on cloud infrastructure and internal software, not semiconductor fabrication plants.
kpis.signal: Moderate but rising capex for cloud

kpis.name: Recurring Revenue / Subscriptions
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from subscriptions and cloud services.
kpis.description: Driven by Evergreen, Portworx, and cloud offerings, this revenue is becoming an increasing share of the total. Represents subscription services revenue of $1.691B in FY2026.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is increasing to support sales, marketing, and product development.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR company facts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $3.663B in the latest fiscal year (FY2026).

kpis.name: Percentage of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud deals that include AI capabilities.
kpis.description: More customers are integrating AI workloads into their data center modernization projects.

kpis.name: Net Bookings
kpis.explanation: Value of new orders signed during the year.
kpis.description: Bookings show strong momentum, driven by large enterprises and hyperscalers.

risks.title: Compromise of information security systems
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked at the top of the report (Item 1A), with strong language ('material adverse impact', 'material interruption', 'significant fines, penalties and liabilities'). Stable trend with enhanced governance framework (ESC, GISO, CISO). Cybersecurity category assigned maximum weight.

risks.title: Legal proceedings that could affect results
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned mid-report (Item 3), with moderate language ('could materially affect our future results of operations, cash flows or financial position'). Stable trend, recurring risk related to ordinary course of business. Litigation category assigned intermediate weight.

risks.title: Dependence on a single major hyperscaler customer
risks.score_rationale: Risk referenced in the MD&A section (mid-report) with neutral but revealing language ('hyperscaler customer' singular, 'large production deployments'). Trend increasing due to strategic focus on this customer. Competition category assigned high weight in case of partner loss.

risks.title: Product revenue volatility based on ordering cycles
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the MD&A section (mid-report) with moderate language ('may vary from period to period'). Stable trend, inherent to hardware sales model. Capital category assigned intermediate weight as it affects cash flow predictability.

risks.title: Rising operating costs impacting profitability
risks.score_rationale: Risk present throughout the MD&A section (mid-report), with repeated and systematic language ('expect...to increase in absolute dollars') for each cost line. Trend increasing, acknowledged by management. Industrial category assigned moderate weight but structural risk to margins.

risks.title: Uncertain future results (forward-looking statements)
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned at the beginning of the MD&A section (mid-report) with strong language ('may differ materially from those anticipated'). Stable trend, standard but significant warning for investors. Capital category as it directly affects valuation and market expectations.

risks.title: Absence of dividends and retained earnings policy
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the stock market section (mid-report) with neutral language ('do not anticipate paying any dividends in the foreseeable future'). Stable trend, consistent policy. Capital category assigned low weight but relevant for income-seeking investors.

ai_positioning.summary: The company PSTG does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
